title: Turnfin Reception Portal
question: Choose the layout for receptionists’ default landing page. All three keep Turnfin’s existing look, site switching and permission-based access. The full interactive previews are at http://127.0.0.1:4198/reception-portal.

options.label: 1. Module directory
options.thesis: Keep reception tools organised by the module they belong to.
options.viewport: A wide Aquatics row with customer shortcuts; Docs and future Bookings underneath.
options.risk: Follow-up tasks are less prominent than module access.

regions.label: Enrolment · ready to move · Legend · parents

options.label: 2. Follow-up queue
options.thesis: Start with outstanding work so handoffs are easy to spot.
options.viewport: Follow-up lists lead the left column; modules stack on the right and customer tasks sit below.
options.risk: Everyday customer tasks sit lower; accurate live queue counts would be needed.

regions.label: Follow up · enrolment · moves · agreements · access

options.label: 3. Reception desk
options.thesis: Keep the most common customer tasks within easy reach.
options.viewport: Aquatics and its shortcuts fill the main panel; Docs and Bookings sit beside it, with follow-up below.
options.risk: Aquatics dominates until the other reception modules grow.

regions.label: Follow up · enrolment · moves · Legend · parent access
